Hopefully, though, this will fix the achievements being unlocked problem

notes.title: Pre-update news
notes.notes:
In order to try and solve (finally) the achievement problem of multiple achievements being unlocked for no reason, I've modified the achievement names both in my game and on Steam.

[b]THIS MEANS THAT ALL PREVIOUS ACHIEVEMENTS (BOTH INTERNAL AND STEAM RELATED) ARE NOW LOST.[/b]

In order to claim these achievements again, just play the game...

The update does add various things, all of which will be detailed when it's released

notes.title: Last update
notes.notes:
This will be the very last update for the WTC OVN, unless anything major is found.

This update changes one background (which I've never liked), and put in the new achievement system that will hopefully remove all of the initial achievement problems.

Note, however, due to how the TOTTALLYDONE achievement now works, you may have to go through the BEGOOD/EVIL/INDECISIVE routines again, if you current [u]dont [/u]have it.

notes.title: So, what's next ?
notes.notes:
Aside from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1041660/]Welcome To... Chichester 3[/url] coming out sometime between the end of 2019 and early 2020 (depending on how quickly the backgrounds are done), there will be a sequel to Welcome To... Chichester 2, which is set directly after the events in that visual novel (early video [url=https://youtu.be/Nt0pP8A3lEw]here[/url] and [url=https://youtu.be/5RlnB68QV74]here[/url])

I'm hoping it will be out well before the end of the year, but again, it's all dependent on graphics (especially as there are new characters).

In addition to that, the backgrounds to Redux are being updated as well (and there will be a new DLC for that), as well as a few dialogue changes.

And then, after that it's the last series.  I haven't yet decided whether to do one large visual novel or split it into three yet, so we'll see.

Of course, it will cover who (or what) killed Cindi (and why), what happened to Grendel's father (as mentioned in Redux/1) and various other bits too.

Hopefully, I can also start getting The Mansion converted to a visual novel and finally released too
